app.title: Microbiology Data Analysis Tool
app.summary: A person uploads a CSV or Excel table of experiment measurements. The tool drops rows with missing values, shows the raw and cleaned tables, and works out the experiment type from the column names: a growth curve, plate colony counts, or a control-versus-antibiotic comparison. For that type it shows key metrics, one or two charts and a plain-language summary. The person then downloads the summary and the statistics as a text or PDF report.

task.text: Turn an uploaded table of bacterial counts into type-specific summary statistics, charts and a downloadable experiment report.

data.text: A small table of counts, from one of three layouts: counts over time, counts per plate, or control and treated counts over time
data.item: a row of the table: one time point or one plate with its bacterial or colony count

stage.text: analysing counts from a finished lab experiment and writing a short report on them

mechanism.text: One file upload in the sidebar drives the whole page from top to bottom: automatic cleaning, data tables you can expand, a detected type that decides which metrics and matplotlib charts appear, a generated summary, and two download buttons for reports.

field.text: bacterial growth, colony counting and antibiotic inhibition assays in microbiology

workflow.name: compute summary statistics from an uploaded table and export a report

steps.here: the sidebar file uploader takes a CSV or Excel file, and the sidebar lists the expected column names for each experiment type
rows with any missing value are dropped automatically, a warning gives the number removed, and the raw and cleaned tables can be opened in expanders

keywords in the column names (antibiotic/control, plate/colony, time/bacteria/count) classify the table as a growth curve, colony count or antibiotic comparison, with a fallback based on column types; the result is shown in a banner

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: four metric tiles show the values for the detected type: initial and final count, growth rate and growth factor; or mean, max, min and std per plate; or the final control and treated counts with percent reduction

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: a line chart of count over time, a bar chart per plate, or overlaid control and antibiotic lines, beside a histogram of the counts with a KDE curve
a plain-language summary is generated from a template for the detected type
download buttons save a timestamped .txt report or an FPDF-built PDF report with the summary and every statistic

distinctive: The experiment type is inferred from column names alone, and that one choice decides which metrics, charts and summary appear
Antibiotic inhibition is reported as the percent reduction of the treated final count relative to the control final count
Growth is given both as a linear rate (count change per time unit) and as a growth factor (final count over initial count)

parts.title: Data upload sidebar
parts.summary: Takes a CSV or Excel file and lists the column layouts that each experiment type expects.

parts.title: Raw and cleaned data
parts.summary: Drops rows with missing values, shows the raw and cleaned tables in expanders, and reports the detected experiment type.

parts.title: Key metrics
parts.summary: Four metric tiles with the statistics for the detected type: growth rate and factor, plate count spread, or percent reduction by the antibiotic.

parts.title: Visualizations
parts.summary: Two columns of charts: a growth line, a bar chart of colonies per plate, or control and antibiotic curves, next to a histogram of the counts.

parts.title: Experiment summary and report
parts.summary: Writes a plain-language summary of the statistics and offers it, with every computed value, as a text or PDF download.
